notes: Routes one channel voice message to its handler, and implements the sequencer's loop controller: 0x63/0x14 saves every track's position and registers, 0x63/0x1E restores them and counts the loop down.

name: SD_ReadSequenceEvent
evidence: local matching body reads a status byte with MIDI running-status handling, takes the operand count from D_80011484, then calls SD_DispatchSequenceChannelEvent, SD_SkipSequenceSysEx or SD_HandleSequenceMetaEvent; sole caller is SD_ProcessSequenceTracks when a track's delta expires
notes: Reads one event from a track, resolving running status, and hands it to the channel, system-exclusive or meta handler.

name: SD_OpenSequenceTrack
evidence: local matching body calls SD_FindMidiTrackChunk on the track's position and fills the chunk length, start and end triple at +0x08, +0x0C and +0x10; returns 1 when no MTrk marker is found
notes: Positions a track at its next MTrk chunk and records that chunk's length, start and end. Currently has no caller in matched C.

name: SD_ScaleSequenceDelta
evidence: local matching body switches on SDSecondaryState::timebase and rescales track->delta_remaining, carrying the remainder in field_0018; called from SD_ProcessSequenceTracks and SD_StartSequenceTracks when field_0804 is set
notes: Converts a track's delta count from the sequence's own timebase to the runtime tick, keeping the fractional remainder for the next event.

name: SD_StartSequenceTracks
evidence: local matching body calls SD_ReadSequenceHeader then, for every track, saves the position, reads the first delta and clears the ended, running-status and remainder fields; both callers set the data pointer and length immediately before it and set the playing state immediately after
notes: Prepares every track for playback from the start: reads the header, then primes each track's first delta and clears its per-run state.

name: SD_GetSequenceStatus
evidence: local matching body returns 3 only when every track's ended flag is set and 1 otherwise; sole caller func_80049F50 promotes a 3 into SDSecondaryState::field_07E2 as the finished state
notes: Reports whether the sequence has finished: 3 once every track has run off the end of its chunk, 1 while any track is still playing.

name: DisplayObject_ResetVelocity
evidence: matching body; DisplayObjectVelocity view in display_object_helpers.h; name_entry_runtime.c drives 0x36/0x38 as a velocity pair
notes: Zeroes the three velocity components and primes the three 8.8 position fractions to 0x80; returns without touching a null object.

name: DisplayObject_StepPositionX

notes: Adds velocity_x to the 8.8 fixed-point x position, carrying the remainder in fraction_x.

name: DisplayObject_StepPositionY

notes: Adds velocity_y to the 8.8 fixed-point y position, carrying the remainder in fraction_y.

name: DisplayObject_StepPositionZ
evidence: matching body; DisplayObjectVelocity view in display_object_helpers.h; name_entry_runtime.c drives 0x36/0x38 as a velocity pair
notes: Adds velocity_z to the 8.8 fixed-point z position, carrying the remainder in fraction_z.

name: DisplayObject_StepPositionXY
evidence: matching body; DisplayObjectVelocity view in display_object_helpers.h; name_entry_runtime.c drives 0x36/0x38 as a velocity pair
notes: Steps the x and y position components; the two-axis form the screen-space widgets call.

name: DisplayObject_StepPositionXYZ
evidence: matching body; DisplayObjectVelocity view in display_object_helpers.h; name_entry_runtime.c drives 0x36/0x38 as a velocity pair
notes: Steps all three position components.

name: DisplayObject_StepToward
evidence: matching body; name_entry_runtime.c accelerates a fall velocity toward 0x800 by 0x40 per frame
notes: Moves a value one step toward a target and clamps on arrival; the branch tests the target sign rather than the difference, so the caller supplies a target on the side it approaches from.

name: DisplayObject_StepTowardZero
evidence: matching body; name_entry_runtime.c decays a horizontal velocity toward zero by 8 per frame
notes: Moves a value one step toward zero and clamps there; the decay counterpart of the step-toward-target helper.

name: MemCard_BeginRequest
evidence: matching body; sole caller of every request wrapper; func_80044838 candidate returns -1 while D_8009B43E is negative and resets it to -1 on completion
notes: Refuses with 0 while a request is still pending; otherwise records the channel and request code in D_8009B437 and D_8009B43E, resets the retry and sub-state bytes, and marks gMemCard_nIOResult pending.

name: MemCard_ReqCardInfo
evidence: matching body; request code 1; func_80044608 returns at the _card_info stage for code 1 instead of continuing to _card_clear; no caller or stored address in the executable or DATA files
notes: Starts an asynchronous _card_info on the channel; the poll reports the card's state without clearing it or reloading its directory.

name: MemCard_ReqLoadDirectory
evidence: matching body; request code 2; func_80044608 finishes by enumerating * into D_800F2888 and counting free blocks into D_8009B438; func_8003DC1C issues it straight after InitCARD and MemCard_InitIOEvents
notes: Runs _card_info, _card_clear and _card_load synchronously before leaving request 2 for the poll; the directory is what the request leaves loaded.

name: MemCard_ReqReadFile
evidence: matching body; request code 3; func_80044838 candidate opens bu%02X:<name> O_RDONLY|O_NOWAIT, seeks and reads; func_8003DC1C reads 0x1E00 bytes at 0x200
notes: Queues a read of size bytes at offset from the named file into buf.

name: MemCard_ReqReadSector
evidence: matching body; request code 11; func_80044838 candidate calls _card_read(chan, sector, buf); func_8003DC1C reads one directory frame to 0x80210000
notes: Queues a raw 128-byte sector read that bypasses the file system.

name: MemCard_ReqWriteFile
evidence: matching body; request code 4; func_80044838 candidate opens bu%02X:<name> O_WRONLY|O_NOWAIT, seeks and writes; func_8003DC1C writes a 0xA00-byte header image at offset 0
notes: Queues a write of size bytes from buf to the named file at offset.

name: MemCard_ReqWriteSector
evidence: matching body; request code 12; func_80044838 candidate calls _card_write(chan, sector, buf); func_8003DC1C writes back the frame it read after recomputing its XOR check byte at +0x7F
notes: Queues a raw 128-byte sector write that bypasses the file system.

name: MemCard_ReqCreateFile
evidence: matching body; request code 8; func_80044838 candidate fails with 7 when D_8009B438 plus the block count reaches 16 and 6 when the name already exists, then opens with O_CREAT and the block count in the high half
notes: Queues creation of the named file with the given number of 8 KB blocks.

name: MemCard_FindFiles
evidence: matching body; firstfile/nextfile over bu%02X:<pattern>; func_80044608 lists * into the directory buffer; func_80044838 candidate uses a zero count as the file-does-not-exist test
notes: Fills caller DIRENTRY records with the files matching a pattern, up to 15, and returns the count; retries each step five times.
